recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被瀰漫性浸潤取代，細胞為中到大型、核膜不規則且有摺痕的異型淋巴球，夾雜較大的空泡狀核細胞；需配合 HTLV-1 血清學與 CD4+/CD25+ 表現型才能診斷成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse effacement by medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, indented and convoluted nuclear contours
Admixed larger cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Prominent extravasated red cells and small vessels in the background
describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse effacement of the architecture by a polymorphous infiltrate of medium-sized to large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have irregular, indented to convoluted nuclei with coarse to vesicular chromatin, and a subset shows small nucleoli. Background contains abundant extravasated erythrocytes; no residual follicles are seen in this field. Morphology alone is not specific; in the setting of HTLV-1 seropositivity and a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with nodal involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS can look identical and is separated by negative HTLV-1 serology/lack of clonally integrated HTLV-1 provirus.
AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks and TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13) on clear cells.
DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5-positive with round vesicular nuclei rather than CD3+/CD4+ convoluted T cells.
